## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename leaves the agent guide's pre-push instruction pointing at the removed `make test` target, which should be fixed because the guide says these commands are the only checks a change gets. The added Layout entries match the files at the pull-request head.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the pre-push command in AGENTS.md to `make check` — Running `make test` as the guide instructs now fails with no rule for the target, because this line renames it to `check` while `AGENTS.md:24` still reads "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." The pull request updates `README.md:7` and names `check` in the new Layout line at `AGENTS.md:10`, but leaves line 24 unchanged. — Contributors and agents following the guide get a make error instead of a test run, in a repository the guide says has no CI. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to name `make check`.
